value.name: Lucia urges delaying the decision
value.description: Lucia tells Daniel not to rush severing ties to the house and asks to seek the truth before deciding its fate.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, I know you're scared, but the essence of our family is woven into these walls; let’s not rush to sever those ties—our mother poured her heart into this place, and we owe it to her memory to seek the truth before we decide its fate."

value.name: Asha calls for honoring their mother's wishes
value.description: Asha argues that the siblings owe their mother a pause to reflect on the house's meaning before making any decision.
evidence: Asha: "We owe it to our mother to pause and ensure we honor her true wishes; let's take this time to reflect on what the house means to each of us, allowing those memories to guide our next steps."

value.name: Daniel demands selling the house
value.description: Daniel rejects nostalgia, saying he needs to uncover the truth and sell the house before he is left with nothing.
evidence: Daniel: "Reflect all you want, but I can’t afford to let this house become a shrine to nostalgia while my life crumbles—let’s uncover the truth and sell it before I’m left with nothing."

value.name: Asha warns against rushing the decision
value.description: Asha responds that rushing could make them lose sight of their mother's wishes and the bonds between them.
evidence: Asha: "Daniel, I understand your urgency, but rushing this could mean losing sight of what truly matters—our mother's wishes and the bonds that tie us together. Let's take a moment to reflect on her legacy before we make any decisions."

value.name: Rosa pleads for respect for their mother's legacy
value.description: Rosa implores Daniel to see the house as a legacy of love and memories rather than a financial burden.
evidence: Rosa: "Daniel, I implore you to consider that our mother’s legacy isn’t just a financial burden; it’s a tapestry of love and memories that deserves our respect—let us not be so quick to unravel it."

value.name: Lucia warns fear could haunt them

evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, I know the pressure feels immense, but we can't let fear dictate our actions; our mother's love is woven into every corner of this house, and we owe it to her to uncover the truth before we make a choice that could haunt us forever."
